content: A parameterization induces a mirror-flow implicit bias only if the Lie bracket span of its gradient vector fields lies in the kernel of its Jacobian; therefore, a parameterization that violates this necessary condition does not induce a mirror-flow implicit bias of the same form as one that satisfies it.
